offence: Breach of Article 34.8 of the FIA Formula One Sporting Regulations and Appendix L, Chapter IV, Article 5 d) of the International Sporting Code.
penalty: Reprimand (Driving) This is the driver's 1st reprimand of the season.
reason: The Stewards heard from the driver of Car 27 (Nico Hulkenberg), team representative and reviewed video, team radio and in-car video evidence and determined that Car 27 overtook two cars in the fast lane, in breach of Article 34.8 of the FIA Formula One Sporting Regulations and Appendix L, Chapter IV, Article 5 d) of the International Sporting Code. The driver explained that he checked if he was permitted to do so and the team (incorrectly) confirmed that he could. We confirmed this by listening to the team radio. Notwithstanding the team's incorrect instructions, the driver ought to have known the regulations and should not have overtaken in the pit lane. We therefore impose a reprimand.
